builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Caitlyn: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (28,149 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.5% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A ranged zoning marksman who turns traps and net hits into long-range Headshots while using Q to pressure lines of enemies. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Hexoptics C44 → Infinity Edge → Rapid Firecannon. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Berserker's Greaves, Lord Dominik's Regards, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: Hexoptics C44 → Infinity Edge → Rapid Firecannon, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Hexoptics C44 → Infinity Edge → Rapid Firecannon) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.5% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Hexoptics C44 → Infinity Edge → Rapid Firecannon.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Every [5] Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as [(1 + 1)] for building towards a Headshot.

Headshots deal an additional [((characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.6, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.20000000298023224, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.20000000298023224, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + ((1) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1)))) × AD] physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by {{Spell_CaitlynEntrapment_Name}} and {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}}. Headshots against enemies hit by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} deal a further @spell.CaitlynW:HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage.
Caitlyn fires a net, pushing her backwards. The net Slows the first target hit by [50]% for [1] second and deals [80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for [1.5] seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for [30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50] seconds, and [3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5] traps may be active at once. This Ability has [3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5] charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional [35 / 80 / 125 / 170 / 215 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage from Headshot.

Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing [(300 / 475 / 650 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.

Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing [50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (1.25 / 1.45 / 1.65 / 1.85 / 2.05) × AD] physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals [(50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (1.25 / 1.45 / 1.65 / 1.85 / 2.05) × AD) × (0.6)] physical damage.

Enemies revealed by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} always take full damage.

builds.name: Trap Full Pierce
builds.summary: Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal.
builds.goal: Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal.
builds.hypothesis: Q loses damage after the front target unless the rear enemy is W revealed. W also gives stronger long-range Headshot. AD/crit support P/R documented scaling; Shojin tests more trap/Q access without treating Q as ordinary crit.
testPlan: Required state: Trap a rear target behind a front unit before Q passes through.
Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Trap avoidance or movement loses full Q exception.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Headshot crit scaling does not make Q an ordinary critical attack.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Spear of Shojin, Infinity Edge, The Collector, Lord Dominik's Regards, Essence Reaver, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Critical duel
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Caitlyn: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A ranged zoning marksman who turns traps and net hits into long-range Headshots while using Q to pressure lines of enemies. Keep trap/net Headshots separate from ordinary crit attacks. Compare range-safe trap setup with a physical ability/pick route and record whether Q damage survives target blocking. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Caitlyn: Keep trap/net Headshots separate from ordinary crit attacks. Compare range-safe trap setup with a physical ability/pick route and record whether Q damage survives target blocking.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.

The route fails Caitlyn's stated kit question: Keep trap/net Headshots separate from ordinary crit attacks. Compare range-safe trap setup with a physical ability/pick route and record whether Q damage survives target blocking.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.
Full cost 16,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Infinity Edge, Immortal Shieldbow, Lord Dominik's Regards are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Net Magic Retreat
builds.summary: Separate net, Headshot and Spellblade damage during retreat.
builds.goal: Separate net, Headshot and Spellblade damage during retreat.
builds.hypothesis: E has 0.8 AP magic damage and grants Headshot access. Rocketbelt adds movement, Lich Bane a separate attack after E, and Cosmic follows the magic hit. P/Headshot remains physical, so the AP escape trade sacrifices Q/R AD output.
testPlan: Required state: Land E and use Headshot access before retreating.
Separate net, Headshot and Spellblade damage during retreat; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Net interception or low physical damage outweighs the E gain.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: E AP scaling does not convert Headshot to magic.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Lich Bane, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
